sentences.japanese: ついに年貢の納め時が来たか。
sentences.english: I guess the time of reckoning has arrived at last.

sentences.japanese: 資産家は高額の所得税を納めなければならない。
sentences.english: A man of wealth has to pay a lot of income tax.

sentences.japanese: 私たちは税金を納めなければならない。
税金を納めるのは私たちの義務だと思っています。
sentences.english: We think that it's our duty to pay taxes.

sentences.japanese: 民主党が大勝利を納めたが、我々の前進を疎外してきた分断を癒す決断と謙虚さをもって我々は対処しなければならない。
sentences.english: While the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.
